goal: Move the file-metadata fields and their implementation from FileEntry into FileAttributes and update FileEntry to use FileAttributes (delegation), reducing FileEntry's size and concentrating metadata behavior in the new class.

ops.details: Move the listed fields from FileEntry into FileAttributes. In FileEntry add a new private final FileAttributes attributes; initialize it in both FileEntry constructors (new FileAttributes(file)). Remove the moved fields from FileEntry. Ensure SerializableFileTime and other referenced types are available to FileAttributes.

Move the implementation of the listed methods from FileEntry into FileAttributes. The refresh(File) implementation moved here will operate on the fields now owned by FileAttributes. After moving, the methods themselves must no longer contain duplicate state in FileEntry.

Update FileEntry so that public accessor and mutator methods either delegate to the new FileAttributes instance (attributes.getName(), attributes.setExists(...), attributes.refresh(file), etc.) or are removed if their functionality is fully replaced and callers are updated. Specifically: replace usages of moved fields and methods inside FileEntry with delegation to attributes. Add a private final FileAttributes attributes field and initialize it in both constructors: this.attributes = new FileAttributes(file); Ensure getLastModifiedFileTime(), getLastModified(), getName(), getLength(), isDirectory(), isExists() in FileEntry forward to attributes to preserve external behavior where delegation is desired. Update the constructor that takes (FileEntry parent, File file) to pass file to FileAttributes constructor. Keep children/parent management in FileEntry unchanged.

Ensure FileAttributes imports java.io.File, java.io.IOException, java.nio.file.Files, java.nio.file.attribute.FileTime and references to FileUtils and FileTimes are available. Update FileEntry imports if delegation introduces references to FileAttributes. Remove now-unused imports from FileEntry (for example imports only needed by moved code).

Update related tests affected by this refactoring block so the configured build command passes. Adjust imports, package references, moved class references, constructors, and assertions only when required. Do not change production behavior through tests.
